english.title: Disobey a safety notice / sign on the Tyne and Wear Metro
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) whilst on part of the Tyne and Wear Metro, without good cause, disobeyed a safety notice
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 12(1) and 31(1) of the Tyne and Wear Metro Byelaws made under sections 58 and 62 of the Tyneside Metropolitan Railway Act 1973.

english.notes:
(i) Byelaw 30 make provisions in relation to name and addresses.
(ii) Byelaw 31(2) provides powers for the removal of persons.
(iii) Byelaw 31(3) provides that when using these powers, an authorised person, including a constable, must show his/her identification if requested.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant whilst on part of the Tyne and Wear Metro, without good cause, disobeyed a safety notice.
